pr_title: [QUIC] Removes abstract providers and mock from S.N.Quic
pr_body:
Guts out mock provider and the abstract machinery in S.N.Quic enabling to have multiple implementation.
~Leaves in one static `QuicProvider` with `IsSupported`, `CreateConnectionAsync` and `CreateListenerAsync`.~
Also removes `QuicProvider` and moves statics into `QuicListener` and `QuicConnection` as discussed in API Review.

This change is not changing anything functionally (for MsQuic implementation), only removes (Mock implementation) and shuffles some code around.

Further step: move code from `MsQuic...` classes directly to `Quic...` classes. It'll make debugging easier but it'll make future experiments with different implementation slightly harder. It still might be worth it, but left out of this PR for now.

I've checked the generated assemblies and `IsSupported` doesn't throw anywhere as is expected.

Fixes #54050, #53688, #55995, #70424, #56005
